verdict.rationale: OpenTofu explicitly markets for_each-based dynamic provider configs as 'perfect for multi-region deployments, multi-environment setups (dev/staging/prod)' and supports workspaces as a Terraform-compatible feature, but no dedicated docs/evidence in the pack describe a first-class 'stacks' feature or workspace command usage for environment isolation—support is inferred mainly from drop-in Terraform compatibility claims rather than direct workspace/stack documentation.
